meta.full_name: Agentic Process Automation — Domain Matrix & Simulation Catalog
meta.source: Reproduced from Shobhit's APA Simulation Catalog (apadomainmatrixtoolkit.netlify.app), Backbase internal collateral, v1.1 (29 Mar 2026).
meta.reproduced_for: Shyam Mohan — local reusable knowledge module
meta.note: Carbon copy of the framework + data so engagements tap a local source, not the Netlify build. Re-base all $/% figures on client data before client-facing use.

framework.thesis: Elastic Operations — scale operations without linear headcount growth; elastic capacity delivered through humans + agents + workflows.

banking_os_layers.role: Unified Frontline — composable workspaces, branch, mobile, contact centre
Agent Studio + Agent Orchestration — the agents that plan/execute multi-step tasks
Intelligence Fabric — intent classification, propensity, outcome prediction, risk scoring
Authority Layer — decides what each actor (customer/employee/AI agent) may do; every action checked against bank policy before it executes; immutable audit. Official Backbase product name.
NEXUS Semantic Layer — Banking Ontology + Customer State Graph (one real-time customer view across cores). Official Backbase product name.
Grand Central — iPaaS, connectors, Unified Domain Model to systems of record

per_process_method.desc: Quantified $ bleed per process step + narrative — the current-state pain, sized.
Growth Restored · Efficiency Gained · Control Enforced, with recovery math.

agentic_tiers.desc: Agent reasons over NEXUS, plans & executes across systems inside Sentinel guardrails; human at the risk gate only.

l1_automation_matrix._legend: Automation potential per LOB × core domain. HIGH = strong agentic fit; MED = partial; LOW = mostly automated/low-leverage.

steps.name: Service Request Intake
steps.customer: Self-serve portal + AI chat captures request type, urgency, account context instantly
steps.agentDesc: NLP classifies request type + urgency, writes to NEXUS State: Request Initiated. SENTINEL Intent Policy gates routing.
steps.intelDesc: NLP classifies request intent + urgency → NEXUS State: Request Initiated. Confidence score → SENTINEL Intent Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Bank configures which intents route straight-through vs human review • Low-confidence NLP → mandatory agent escalation • Sensitive request types (closure, dispute) flagged immediately • Channel authentication verified before intake accepted
steps.nexusAttrs: Request type, channel, urgency, account context written to Customer State Graph. Triage Agent reads; Fulfillment Agent consumes downstream.

steps.name: Request Processing & Fulfillment
steps.customer: Client sees live status updates; RM dashboard shows fulfillment progress and exceptions only
steps.agentDesc: Executes limit changes, statement reissues, mandate updates autonomously. Reads NEXUS State: Request Initiated. SENTINEL Fulfillment Policy governs autonomy threshold.
steps.intelDesc: Outcome prediction ML scores straight-through eligibility → NEXUS State: Request Fulfilled. Score → SENTINEL Fulfillment Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Bank sets which request types allow full agent autonomy • Complex or high-value changes require ops confirmation step • Fulfillment actions outside policy scope escalated automatically • Every action produces immutable audit token
steps.nexusAttrs: Fulfillment outcome, timestamp, operator ID written to Customer State Graph. Downstream dispute detection reads from here.

steps.name: Dispute & Exception Handling
steps.customer: Dispute queue auto-prioritised; AI evidence bundle pre-assembled; analyst reviews exceptions only
steps.agentDesc: Parallel: Dispute Agent pulls transaction evidence + chargeback rules; Exception Agent flags policy breaches. Both write to NEXUS State: Under Review. SENTINEL Dispute Policy governs resolution authority.
steps.intelDesc: Fraud + anomaly ML scores dispute validity → NEXUS State: Under Review. Fraud score → SENTINEL Dispute Policy resolution routing.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Fraud score above threshold → auto-provisional credit issued • Ambiguous disputes → human analyst queue with AI evidence bundle • Chargeback eligibility rules enforced per scheme (Visa/Mastercard) • Resolution SLA monitored; breach triggers automatic escalation
steps.nexusAttrs: Dispute type, fraud score, transaction evidence, chargeback eligibility added to Customer State Graph. Exception Agent and Case Manager read from here.

steps.name: Account Maintenance & Closure
steps.customer: Digital closure or maintenance confirmation; RM notified of high-value account exits instantly
steps.agentDesc: Executes maintenance updates or closure sequence: sweeps balances, revokes entitlements, archives state. Writes to NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted. SENTINEL Closure Policy governs cooling-off and retention rules.
steps.intelDesc: Churn ML scores exit risk → NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted. Retention score → SENTINEL Closure Policy retention trigger.
steps.sentinelDesc: • High churn-risk score → retention offer workflow auto-triggered before closure proceeds • Cooling-off period enforced per jurisdiction regulatory rules • Balance sweep and entitlement revocation sequenced by policy, not ops discretion • Immutable closure record written to audit ledger
steps.nexusAttrs: Final account status, closure reason, retention outcome, entitlement revocations written to persistent Customer State Graph. Available for regulatory reporting.

steps.name: Account Setup & Core Banking Config
steps.customer: NEXUS-pre-filled account form · core banking config auto-proposed · RM confirms
steps.agentDesc: Reads approved deal terms from NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted · pushes account schema to core banking · writes to NEXUS State: Account Configured · SENTINEL enforces provisioning policy
steps.intelDesc: Not applicable at this stage
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted — approved deal must exist before setup • Bank configures: auto-provision vs ops-confirm step threshold • Account limits set by policy, not ops discretion • Any deviation triggers exception workflow
steps.nexusAttrs: Account number, limits, currency, product codes written to Customer State Graph. Read by Entitlement Agent next.

steps.name: Product & Service Entitlement
steps.customer: Approved product bundle displayed · entitlements auto-assigned · RM confirms exceptions only
steps.agentDesc: Reads approved product bundle from NEXUS State: Account Configured · assigns channel + service entitlements · writes to NEXUS State: Entitled · SENTINEL enforces entitlement eligibility policy
steps.intelDesc: Cross-sell ML reads NEXUS State: Account Configured → eligibility bundle. Score → SENTINEL Entitlement Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads product eligibility score from Intelligence Layer before assigning entitlements • Bank configures which products require manual RM approval vs auto-assign • Unapproved product combinations blocked automatically • All entitlement decisions logged with immutable audit token
steps.nexusAttrs: Product codes, channel access rights, fee schedules written to Customer State Graph. Provisioning Agent reads from here.

steps.name: Treasury & Signatories Authorization
steps.customer: Digital mandate builder · signatory roles auto-proposed from NEXUS · e-sign workflow launched
steps.agentDesc: Reads signatory list from NEXUS State: Ownership Mapped · configures payment limits + dual-control rules · SENTINEL enforces mandate policy · writes to NEXUS State: Authorized
steps.intelDesc: IDP NLP extracts mandate terms from uploaded docs → NEXUS State: Authorized. Confidence score → SENTINEL Mandate Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads signatory confidence score from Intelligence Layer before activating mandate • Bank configures dual-control thresholds per payment type and limit tier • Unverified signatory blocks treasury activation automatically • Full mandate audit chain written — immutable, regulator-ready
steps.nexusAttrs: Signatory roles, payment limits, dual-control rules, e-sign timestamps written to Action Graph. Activation Agent reads from here.

steps.name: Client Activation & Handoff
steps.customer: RM + client notified simultaneously · all channels live · relationship context pre-loaded
steps.agentDesc: Reads NEXUS State: Authorized · activates all entitlements simultaneously · triggers onboarding NPS · writes to NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted · SENTINEL enforces go-live readiness policy
steps.intelDesc: Not applicable at this stage
steps.sentinelDesc: • Validates NEXUS states: Account Configured + Entitled + Authorized all present before activation • Bank configures: partial activation allowed vs full-pack required • Activation blocked if any mandatory step is incomplete or exception unresolved • Activation event written to audit ledger — timestamp, approver, channel
steps.nexusAttrs: Active status, entitlements, signatory config, covenant monitoring rules persisted. Context survives into servicing and relationship lifecycle.

steps.name: Service Request Intake & Routing
steps.customer: Natural language request intake · auto-classified · priority surfaced to RM Workspace instantly
steps.agentDesc: NLP classifies intent, reads NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted, routes to correct fulfillment workflow. SENTINEL Intake Policy governs SLA tier assignment.
steps.intelDesc: NLP classifies request type + urgency → NEXUS State: Request Initiated. Priority score → SENTINEL SLA Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Request type + client tier determines SLA lane automatically • High-value clients flagged → RM notified within 60 seconds • Ambiguous requests → Conversational AI clarification loop • No manual triage — routing policy enforced consistently
steps.nexusAttrs: Request type, urgency, client tier, SLA lane written to Customer State Graph. Triage Agent writes; Maintenance Agent reads.

steps.name: Account Maintenance & Changes
steps.customer: Maintenance requests tracked live · digital mandate capture · no paper forms · status visible
steps.agentDesc: Executes limit changes, signatory updates, mandate amendments. Reads NEXUS State: Request Initiated. Writes to NEXUS State: Maintained. SENTINEL Change Authority Policy gates every write.
steps.intelDesc: Anomaly detection flags unusual mandate changes → NEXUS State: Maintained. Risk score → SENTINEL Change Authority Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Low-risk changes (e.g. address) = full agent autonomy, no human step • Signatory or limit changes → RM countersign required • Mandate amendments > threshold → ops supervisor approval • Every change creates immutable audit token in SENTINEL
steps.nexusAttrs: Updated signatories, limits, mandate version, change timestamp written to Customer State Graph. Audit trail persisted.

steps.name: Transaction Dispute & Investigation
steps.customer: Dispute case auto-opened · transaction evidence pre-assembled · investigator queue prioritised by value
steps.agentDesc: Pulls full transaction chain, counterparty data, account history from NEXUS. Runs fraud ML. SENTINEL Dispute Resolution Policy governs auto-credit vs escalation thresholds.
steps.intelDesc: Fraud pattern ML scores dispute → NEXUS State: Under Investigation. Confidence score → SENTINEL Dispute Resolution Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • High-confidence fraud + low value → auto-credit, no human step • Low-confidence or high-value → investigator assigned in Case Manager • Chargeback rules enforced per scheme (SWIFT, SEPA, Bacs) automatically • Resolution SLA tracked; breach triggers automatic escalation
steps.nexusAttrs: Transaction chain, fraud score, counterparty flags, case status written to Customer State Graph and Action Graph.

steps.name: Reporting, Statements & Covenant Monitoring
steps.customer: On-demand statements · covenant dashboard · automated breach alerts surfaced to RM and client simultaneously
steps.agentDesc: Covenant Agent reads NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted continuously, evaluates ratios, writes breach flags. Reporting Agent generates statements on-demand. SENTINEL Covenant Policy gates escalation.
steps.intelDesc: Time-series ML predicts covenant breach 30 days ahead → NEXUS State: Monitored. Risk signal → SENTINEL Covenant Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Breach predicted 30 days out → RM early-warning alert triggered automatically • Actual breach → relationship review workflow opened in Case Manager • Reporting frequency and format enforced per client agreement, not manual scheduling • All covenant events logged immutably for regulatory audit
steps.nexusAttrs: Covenant ratios, breach flags, statement history, alert timestamps written continuously to Customer State Graph.

steps.name: Screening & Risk Scoring
steps.customer: Entity risk profile auto-populated · sanctions hits · risk tier surfaced instantly
steps.agentDesc: Runs sanctions, PEP, adverse media simultaneously · writes risk_tier to NEXUS State: Screened · SENTINEL Intake Policy gates proceed vs. escalate
steps.intelDesc: Entity matching + sanctions NLP → NEXUS State: Screened. Risk tier score → SENTINEL Intake Policy routing.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads risk_tier from Intelligence Layer screening output • Clean = auto-proceed to KYB stage • Sanctions/PEP hit = mandatory escalation, no bypass • Jurisdiction risk triggers enhanced review threshold
steps.nexusAttrs: Sanctions flags, PEP status, adverse media markers, risk tier written to Customer State Graph. KYB Agent reads from here.

steps.name: KYB & UBO Verification
steps.customer: Interactive ownership chart · director KYC queue · registry verification status live
steps.agentDesc: Parallel: entity registry checks + 5+ ownership layers traced · writes Ownership Mapped to NEXUS · SENTINEL Autonomy Policy gates agent vs. human decision
steps.intelDesc: Graph ML traces 5+ UBO layers → NEXUS State: Ownership Mapped. Confidence score → SENTINEL Autonomy Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads UBO confidence score from Intelligence Layer graph ML • High confidence + clean = full agent autonomy, no human needed • Complex structure or low confidence = compliance officer review triggered • Bank configures ownership depth threshold and complexity rules
steps.nexusAttrs: UBO chain, director KYC statuses, registry confirmation, beneficial ownership % written to Customer State Graph.

steps.name: Enhanced Due Diligence Review
steps.customer: AI-drafted EDD narrative · source-of-wealth evidence · analyst review queue prioritised
steps.agentDesc: Aggregates adverse media, source-of-wealth docs, PEP network analysis · drafts EDD memo · writes EDD Complete to NEXUS · SENTINEL EDD Policy enforces mandatory fields
steps.intelDesc: NLP adverse media + SoW document analysis → NEXUS State: EDD Complete. Risk narrative score → SENTINEL EDD Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads adverse media NLP score and SoW confidence from Intelligence Layer • Bank configures mandatory EDD fields — no approval without full pack • Incomplete narrative = automated analyst chase, not silent stall • High-risk PEP findings auto-escalate to senior compliance officer
steps.nexusAttrs: EDD narrative, source-of-wealth evidence, PEP network context, adverse media summary written to Customer State Graph.

steps.name: Approval, Audit & Ongoing Monitoring
steps.customer: One-click approval with SENTINEL evidence bundle · monitoring alerts live post-approval
steps.agentDesc: Routes to correct approver per NEXUS risk tier · issues immutable audit token · activates ongoing monitoring rules · writes Lifecycle Persisted to NEXUS
steps.intelDesc: Continuous adverse media + sanctions ML → NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted. Alert score → SENTINEL Monitoring Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads cumulative risk tier from NEXUS State: EDD Complete to determine approver level • Low risk = RM approval · high risk = compliance committee required • Immutable audit token issued per decision — full regulatory traceability • Post-approval: SENTINEL Monitoring Policy triggers re-screen on new adverse media events
steps.nexusAttrs: Approval decision, audit token, monitoring thresholds, re-screen schedule written to persistent Customer State Graph.

steps.name: Financial Spreading & Borrower Analysis
steps.customer: Auto-spread financials displayed instantly · 3-yr trend · ratio dashboard · zero manual entry
steps.agentDesc: Extracts 3-yr P&L, balance sheet, cash flow from uploaded docs · writes spreads to NEXUS State: Financially Spreading · SENTINEL Data Quality Policy gates progression
steps.intelDesc: IDP extracts 100+ financial fields → NEXUS State: Financially Spreading. Completeness score → SENTINEL Data Quality Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc:
• Completeness threshold (e.g. 95%+) configured by bank · auto-chase if below
• Anomaly detection flags outlier ratios for analyst review
• Period consistency check: 3 full fiscal years required before progression
• Bank configures which doc types are mandatory — no RM override
steps.nexusAttrs: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, 100+ ratios written to Customer State Graph. Risk Rating Agent reads from here.

steps.name: Risk Rating & Scorecard
steps.customer: Risk scorecard auto-populated · probability of default · risk grade · override justification panel
steps.agentDesc: Reads spreads from NEXUS State: Financially Spreading · runs PD/LGD/EAD models · writes risk grade to NEXUS State: Risk Rated · SENTINEL Override Policy governs analyst adjustments
steps.intelDesc: Credit risk ML produces PD, LGD, EAD → NEXUS State: Risk Rated. Risk grade → SENTINEL Override + Approval Routing Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc:
• Model score is default · analyst override requires documented justification
• Override magnitude cap configured per bank policy (e.g. max 1 notch)
• All overrides logged immutably — full model vs. human audit trail
• SENTINEL reads PD score to pre-determine approval authority tier
steps.nexusAttrs: PD, LGD, EAD, risk grade, override flag written to Customer State Graph. Credit Memo Agent reads risk grade from here.

steps.name: Credit Memo Preparation
steps.customer: AI-drafted credit memo surfaced in Case Manager · analyst reviews, edits, approves · no blank page
steps.agentDesc: Reads all prior NEXUS states (Financially Spreading + Risk Rated) · auto-drafts structured memo with financials, risk grade, covenant proposals · SENTINEL Memo Completeness Policy gates submission
steps.intelDesc: LLM reads NEXUS State: Risk Rated → drafts full credit memo. Completeness score → SENTINEL Memo Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc:
• Bank configures mandatory memo sections · incomplete memo cannot be submitted
• Auto-cross-check: memo figures must match NEXUS-stored spread data
• Covenant terms validated against bank's standard covenant library
• Submission locked until analyst acknowledgement captured as audit event
steps.nexusAttrs: Credit memo version, covenant terms, analyst sign-off written to Action Graph. Approval Routing Agent reads from here.

steps.name: Credit Committee Review & Approval
steps.customer: Committee receives SENTINEL evidence bundle · risk grade · memo · one-click approve or condition
steps.agentDesc: Reads risk grade + deal size from NEXUS State: Risk Rated · SENTINEL Credit Authority Policy determines approver tier · routes to right committee · immutable decision token issued on approval
steps.sentinelDesc:
• ≤$2M: full agent autonomy · no human committee required
• $2M–$10M: RM + Credit Manager sign-off required
• >$10M: full credit committee quorum enforced by SENTINEL
• Conditional approvals: covenants automatically appended to NEXUS Action Graph
steps.nexusAttrs: Approval decision, conditions, approver identity, timestamp written to Action Graph. Immutable audit token issued. Loan Doc Agent reads from here.

steps.name: Loan Documentation & Booking
steps.customer: Loan docs auto-generated · digital signature · booked to core · RM + client notified simultaneously
steps.agentDesc: Reads approved terms from NEXUS State: Credit Decisioned · auto-generates facility agreement · triggers digital signing · books to core banking · writes to NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted · SENTINEL Booking Policy governs activation
steps.intelDesc: Doc generation ML assembles facility agreement from NEXUS State: Credit Decisioned. Covenant terms → NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted.
steps.sentinelDesc:
• Booking only permitted after SENTINEL confirms signed approval token present
• Loan amount, rate, covenants cross-checked against approved terms before activation
• Covenant monitoring rules auto-enabled in core banking at booking
• Bank configures: straight-through booking vs. ops-confirm step per deal size
steps.nexusAttrs: Facility terms, covenant thresholds, monitoring rules, booking reference written to persistent Customer State Graph. Available for servicing lifecycle.

steps.name: Dispute Intake & Triage
steps.customer: Client submits dispute digitally; RM sees auto-triaged case with risk priority score instantly
steps.agentDesc: Classifies dispute type, assigns priority score, writes to NEXUS State: Dispute Initiated. SENTINEL Intake Policy gates SLA routing.
steps.intelDesc: NLP classifies dispute type + fraud signal → NEXUS State: Dispute Initiated. Priority score → SENTINEL Intake Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • NLP priority score gates auto-accept vs manual triage • High fraud signal → immediate freeze workflow triggered • Bank configures dispute type eligibility rules • SLA clock starts on intake confirmation
steps.nexusAttrs: Dispute type, transaction refs, fraud signal, priority score written. All downstream agents read from here.

steps.name: Evidence Collection & Documentation
steps.customer: Guided evidence checklist surfaced; client uploads receipts, contracts, correspondence once — no email
steps.agentDesc: Auto-pulls transaction logs, merchant data, card auth records. IDP extracts uploaded docs. Writes evidence pack to NEXUS State: Evidence Assembled.
steps.intelDesc: IDP extracts fields from receipts + contracts → NEXUS State: Evidence Assembled. Completeness score → SENTINEL.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Completeness threshold bank-configured (e.g. 85%+) • Below threshold → automated client chase triggered • Merchant response deadline enforced per network rules (Visa/MC) • No case advances silently on incomplete evidence
steps.nexusAttrs: Transaction records, merchant data, client docs, auth logs appended to case state. Evidence completeness score tracked.

steps.name: Liability Investigation & Chargeback Decisioning
steps.customer: Investigator sees AI liability recommendation, evidence strength score, and network rule match — one-click decision
steps.agentDesc: Parallel: Liability Agent maps network reason codes; Fraud Agent scores transaction anomaly. Both write to NEXUS State: Liability Assessed. SENTINEL Decision Policy routes outcome.
steps.intel: Fraud Anomaly ML + Liability Reasoning Model
steps.intelDesc: Fraud ML scores transaction anomaly + liability model maps reason codes → NEXUS State: Liability Assessed. Confidence → SENTINEL Decision Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • High-confidence clean liability → full agent autonomy, no human needed • Ambiguous or high-value → investigator review required • Bank configures value thresholds per dispute type and network • Every decision creates immutable audit token
steps.nexusAttrs: Fraud score, liability ruling, network reason code, confidence level written. Action Graph surfaces valid decisions: approve, deny, escalate.

steps.name: Chargeback Filing & Network Submission
steps.customer: RM sees real-time submission status per network; automated deadline tracking visible on case timeline
steps.agentDesc: Auto-formats chargeback package per Visa/MC/AMEX rules, submits via network APIs, logs confirmation. NEXUS State: Filed. SENTINEL Deadline Policy enforces cut-offs.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Bank-configured network deadlines enforced automatically (Visa T+120, MC T+45) • Missed deadline → escalation alert before cut-off, not after • Submission format validated against network schema before send • Confirmation receipt logged to immutable audit ledger
steps.nexusAttrs: Network submission ref, filing timestamp, deadline markers, format validation result written to case state.

steps.name: Resolution, Recovery & Reconciliation
steps.customer: Client notified of outcome instantly; RM sees recovery amount, GL entries auto-posted, case closed
steps.agentDesc: Parallel: Resolution Agent posts recovery credit, notifies client; Reconciliation Agent auto-posts GL entries. NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted. SENTINEL Recovery Policy governs posting.
steps.intelDesc: Recovery likelihood ML scores similar disputes → NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted. Confidence → SENTINEL Recovery Policy for future triage tuning.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Bank configures: full auto-posting below threshold vs ops-confirm step • Client notification triggered only after posting confirmed • Reconciliation audit trail immutably locked on case close • Recovery outcome feeds back to SENTINEL triage calibration
steps.nexusAttrs: Recovery amount, GL ref, client notification status, resolution outcome written. Context persists for analytics, repeat dispute detection, and regulatory reporting.

steps.name: Client Qualification
steps.customer: Auto-enriched entity profile + risk pre-screen result displayed instantly in RM dashboard
steps.agentDesc: Pulls D&B firmographics, Companies House, sanctions pre-screen. Invokes Intelligence Layer Entity Resolution ML for matching + risk scoring. Writes output to NEXUS State: Initiated. Governed by SENTINEL Intake Authority Policy.
steps.intelDesc: Entity matching ML resolves against D&B/registry. Risk scoring ML → writes risk_tier to NEXUS State: Initiated.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads risk_tier from Intelligence Layer Entity Resolution ML • Bank configures which entity types & jurisdictions qualify for straight-through • Flagged types → mandatory RM review • Policy enforced consistently — no RM discretion
steps.nexusAttrs: Customer context created from D&B, Companies House: entity name, LEI, jurisdiction, industry, initial risk indicators. Base state — all downstream agents read from here

steps.name: Corporate Doc Collection
steps.customer: Guided 80-doc checklist · real-time completeness indicator · upload once · no email
steps.agentDesc: Invokes Intelligence Layer OCR models to extract 80+ fields from articles, financials, signatory docs. Zero re-keying. Writes to NEXUS State: Enriched. SENTINEL Completeness Policy gates auto-proceed.
steps.intelDesc: IDP models auto-classify docs + extract 80+ fields. Output → NEXUS State: Enriched. Completeness score → SENTINEL.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Evaluates completeness score from Intelligence Layer OCR extraction • Bank sets threshold (e.g. 90%+) • Below → automated chase workflow triggered • Above → auto-proceed to KYB/KYC stage
steps.nexusAttrs: 80+ extracted fields appended to customer state: signatory list, financial period markers, entity structure. Agents never re-extract — they read from state

steps.name: KYB, Corp KYC & UBO
steps.customer: Compliance queue auto-prioritised · interactive ownership chart · EDD status live · no silent waits
steps.agentDesc: All in parallel: entity KYB + director KYC + 5+ ownership layers + EDD. Invokes Intelligence Layer NLP for PEP/adverse media. Writes to NEXUS State: Risk Profiled. SENTINEL Agent Autonomy governs escalation.
steps.intelDesc: UBO graph traces 5+ layers → NEXUS State: Risk Profiled. PEP matching + adverse media NLP. Confidence score → SENTINEL autonomy gate.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads confidence score from Intelligence Layer NLP/PEP matching • High confidence = full agent autonomy • Low confidence / PEP hit = human-in-loop escalation • Bank configures exact risk thresholds per entity type
steps.nexusAttrs: KYB/KYC statuses, PEP/sanctions flags, adverse media added. UBO chain & EDD. Full compliance context in shared state.

steps.name: Credit Risk & Approval
steps.customer: AI credit memo auto-populated from NEXUS · SENTINEL evidence bundle · one-click approve
steps.agentDesc: Runs parallel with KYC/EDD. Invokes Intelligence Layer Credit ML for spreading + scoring. Writes to NEXUS State: Financially Assessed. SENTINEL Credit Policy routes to approver.
steps.intelDesc: Spreading ML extracts 3-yr financials → NEXUS State: Financially Assessed. Credit score + covenant breach probability → SENTINEL Credit Policy routing.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads credit_score + covenant_risk from Intelligence Layer Credit ML • ≤$2M = full autonomy • $2–10M = RM sign-off required • >$10M = credit committee · immutable audit token issued
steps.nexusAttrs: 3-yr financials, credit score, covenant terms added. NEXUS actions graph surfaces valid decisions — approval, exception, referral.

steps.name: Multi Product Provisioning
steps.customer: RM + client notified simultaneously · all products live · digital mandate signed
steps.agentDesc: Sets up Treasury + Payments + Credit Facility + Online Banking simultaneously · digital mandate · notifies RM + client
steps.intelDesc: Cross-sell ML reads NEXUS State: Financially Assessed. Eligibility scoring → SENTINEL Provisioning Policy. Bundle → NEXUS State: Lifecycle Persisted.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Reads eligibility score from Intelligence Layer Recommendation ML • Approved deals = full autonomy or ops-confirm step • Account limits + monitoring rules set per bank policy • Covenant monitoring auto-enabled post-provisioning
steps.nexusAttrs: Account config, entitlements, monitoring rules, covenant thresholds written to persistent customer state. Context survives onboarding — available for servicing & lifecycle.

steps.name: Transaction Monitoring & Alert Triage
steps.customer: Live alert queue auto-prioritised by risk score · analyst sees full NEXUS context inline
steps.agentDesc: Ingests transaction events, scores via ML, suppresses false positives, writes alert disposition to NEXUS · SENTINEL gates escalation vs auto-close
steps.intelDesc: Behavioural ML scores each alert → NEXUS State: Alert Triaged. Score → SENTINEL Triage Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Bank-configured score threshold determines auto-close vs escalate • High-risk typologies always escalate — no agent override • Alert suppression rules version-controlled and auditable • Every auto-close creates immutable disposition token
steps.nexusAttrs: Transaction pattern, risk score, typology tag written to customer state. SAR Agent reads from here.

steps.name: SAR Investigation & Filing
steps.customer: AI-drafted SAR narrative · analyst reviews, edits, approves · one-click FinCEN/UKFIU submission
steps.agentDesc: Reads NEXUS State: Alert Triaged, drafts SAR narrative via NLP, routes for analyst sign-off · SENTINEL enforces filing deadline SLA
steps.intelDesc: NLP model drafts SAR from NEXUS context → State: SAR Drafted. Completeness score → SENTINEL Filing Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • 30-day FinCEN / 7-day UKFIU SLA enforced automatically • Incomplete narrative blocks submission — completeness check mandatory • Analyst sign-off required before every SAR filing • Filed SAR + evidence bundle written to immutable audit ledger
steps.nexusAttrs: SAR narrative, supporting evidence, analyst sign-off, filing timestamp appended to customer state.

steps.name: Commercial Fraud Detection & Case Management
steps.customer: Fraud case auto-opened · evidence timeline visualised · RM alerted with recommended action
steps.agent: Fraud Detection Agent ∥ Loss Prevention Agent
steps.agentDesc: Parallel agents: Fraud Detection scores transaction networks, Loss Prevention models recovery actions · both write to NEXUS · SENTINEL gates freeze vs monitor decision
steps.intelDesc: Network graph ML detects fraud rings → NEXUS State: Fraud Assessed. Fraud score → SENTINEL Fraud Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Bank configures: high-confidence fraud score = auto account freeze • Mid-range score = RM alert + watchlist • Low score = enhanced monitoring only • Every freeze action requires immutable SENTINEL authorization token
steps.nexusAttrs: Fraud typology, network links, velocity flags, loss estimate written. Loss Prevention Agent reads recovery path.

steps.name: Sanctions Screening & OFAC Compliance
steps.customer: Sanctions hits surface with match confidence · analyst sees full NEXUS entity context · no manual list lookup
steps.agentDesc: Screens all counterparties against OFAC, UN, EU lists continuously · fuzzy-match ML resolves false positives · SENTINEL enforces block vs review · writes to NEXUS
steps.intelDesc: Entity resolution ML scores sanctions matches → NEXUS State: Sanctions Screened. Match score → SENTINEL Sanctions Policy.
steps.sentinelDesc: • Exact match = immediate transaction block, no agent override • Fuzzy match above threshold = human-in-loop review mandatory • Below threshold = auto-clear with logged disposition • All blocks reported to OFAC within bank-configured SLA
steps.nexusAttrs: Match result, confidence score, list source, disposition written to customer state. Regulatory Reporting Agent reads here.

steps.name: Regulatory Reporting & Exam Readiness
steps.customer: Exam pack auto-assembled · regulator dashboard live · zero manual report compilation
steps.agentDesc: Reads full NEXUS audit trail, auto-generates CTR/STR/CMIR reports, assembles exam evidence bundles · SENTINEL validates completeness before submission
steps.sentinelDesc: • CTR filing threshold ($10K+) auto-triggered — no analyst decision needed • All reports validated against schema before regulator submission • Missing evidence blocks submission — completeness enforced by SENTINEL • Full chain-of-custody audit log available on-demand for exam
steps.nexusAttrs: Full audit trail, SAR/CTR filings, sanctions dispositions, fraud cases consolidated into persistent regulatory state.
